title: GTA 6's Original Soundtrack Is Going to Be Incredible, if This Leaked Song Is Anything to Go By
text: GTA 6's Original Soundtrack Is Going to Be Incredible, if This Leaked Song Is Anything to Go By | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA 6 Music GTA 6's Original Soundtrack Is Going to Be Incredible, if This Leaked Song Is Anything to Go By Justice prevails by Stephen Tailby 3 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games is going all-out for GTA 6 , and that includes its original soundtrack. Alongside all the licensed music you'll hear throughout the game, an entirely new score is being produced by Justice, the French electronic duo. So far, only one of the tracks from the OST has been released (officially), and that's Flower in a Hurricane , which plays over GTA 6's launch trailer . However, another OST piece has emerged online recently, and it's brilliant. It's doing the rounds on social media, ahead of what seems to be an official release tomorrow (29th October). GTA 6’s full original score track “Pusher” by Justice and Gesaffelstein. pic.twitter.com/W7EnjsBK8J - GTA 6 Updates (@gtasix_) October 28, 2026 The song is named Pusher , and it's by Justice featuring Gesaffelstein. The seven-minute track is a thumping electronic piece that sounds like something right out of Hotline Miami — I really love the vibe of this. The full, 50-track OST is seemingly being released on 11th December, according to its listing on Apple Music . If it's all of a similar quality to the music we've heard so far, I think we could be in for a fantastic aural experience while playing GTA 6.
